title: 大黒PAの出口でラフェラーリFXX-Kがクラッシュする動画。画像1枚目が大黒PA。手前から奥にむかってFXXが静止した状態でホイルスピンをしながらフル加速して画…
content:
大黒PAの出口でラフェラーリFXX-Kがクラッシュする動画。画像1枚目が大黒PA。手前から奥にむかってFXXが静止した状態でホイルスピンをしながらフル加速して画像奥に向かって加速していく。
しかし50mほど進んだところでリアタイヤがすべってそのまま右側のガードレールにノーズからぶつかりクラッシュしてしまう。
映像はスマートフォンの手持ち風映像で大黒PAにいたギャラリーの日本人が撮影している。
BGMは不要だがクラッシュしたときの効果音、フェラーリが加速するときの甲高いサウンドやタイヤのスキーム音などは生成すること。人のセリフはなし。フォトリアル、6秒の動画。

en.content:
A video of a LaFerrari FXX-K crashing at the exit of Daikoku PA. The first image is Daikoku PA. From the foreground toward the background, the FXX is stationary at first, then does a full-throttle acceleration while wheel-spinning, moving toward the back of the image.

However, after traveling about 50 meters, the rear tires lose traction and it crashes nose-first into the right-side guardrail.

The footage is shot in a smartphone handheld style by a Japanese spectator who was at Daikoku PA.

No BGM is needed, but generate the sound effects for the crash, the high-pitched sound of the Ferrari accelerating, and tire squeal sounds. No human dialogue. Photorealistic, 6-second video.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] The prompt is below.
Also, since I want people to see how deeply Seedance understands things, I deliberately typed everything myself.

In practice, it would be better to ask an AI app called Claude: “I want to make a video of ○○ with Seedance 2.0, so please write the prompt in YAML.”

Then, if you copy and paste the generated prompt into the app and create it, I think you’ll get a much better video than the one in the first post lol

*****Prompt for the first post video starts here*****
A video of a LaFerrari FXX-K crashing at the exit of Daikoku PA. The first image is Daikoku PA. From the foreground toward the background, the FXX is stationary at first, then does a full-throttle acceleration while wheel-spinning, moving toward the back of the image.
However, after traveling about 50 meters, the rear tires lose traction and it crashes nose-first into the right-side guardrail.
The footage is shot in a smartphone handheld style by a Japanese spectator who was at Daikoku PA.
No BGM is needed, but generate the sound effects for the crash, the high-pitched sound of the Ferrari accelerating, and tire squeal sounds. No human dialogue. Photorealistic, 6-second video.

es.content:
Un video de un LaFerrari FXX-K estrellándose en la salida de Daikoku PA. La primera imagen es Daikoku PA. Desde el frente hacia el fondo, el FXX acelera a fondo mientras patina las ruedas desde parado, avanzando hacia el fondo de la imagen.

Sin embargo, después de avanzar unos 50 m, la rueda trasera resbala y el coche termina chocando de frente contra la barrera de protección del lado derecho, provocando el accidente.

La grabación tiene un estilo de vídeo de smartphone en mano, filmado por un japonés que estaba entre el público en Daikoku PA.

No hace falta BGM, pero sí hay que generar los efectos de sonido del momento del choque, el sonido agudo del Ferrari al acelerar y el chirrido de los neumáticos, etc. Sin diálogos. Fotorrealista, vídeo de 6 segundos.

ko.content:
대흑PA 출구에서 라페라리 FXX-K가 크래시하는 영상. 1번째 이미지가 대흑PA다. 앞쪽에서 뒤쪽을 향해 FXX가 정지한 상태로 휠 스핀을 하며 풀가속하고, 화면 뒤쪽을 향해 가속해 나간다.  
하지만 약 50m 정도 진행한 지점에서 뒷타이어가 미끄러지면서 그대로 오른쪽 가드레일에 노즈부터 부딪혀 크래시해 버린다.  
영상은 스마트폰으로 손에 들고 촬영한 듯한 느낌이며, 대흑PA에 있던 일본인 갤러리가 촬영하고 있다.  
BGM은 필요 없지만, 크래시할 때의 효과음, 페라리가 가속할 때의 날카로운 사운드나 타이어 스키드음 등은 생성할 것. 사람의 대사는 없다. 포토리얼, 6초짜리 영상.
